messages.subject: Internal error
parts:
Dear Len,
I am facing a strange error while running analyses on Distance 4.xx software. It says the following:
Unexpected error in Distance Numerical Server.
Source: D4NSvr.NServerItem.RunItem
Internal Error number: -2147023067
Internal Error description: "Automation error".

(Error raised from : DISTANCE.ModGlobal.GenericRunBrowserItem)
(Error source: D4NSvr.NServerItem.RunItem)
Error number: -2147211505)

I am using windows 98 and have tried uninstalling, clearing all folders, reinstalling distance about four times, but it has not helped. Whenever I open an existing or a new file, try running the analysis, the error comes up.

Please let me know if there is some way this error can be gotten rid of.

With gratitude in anticipation,


Koustubh Sharma
Research Analyst-Four-horned Antelope Project
Bombay Natural History Society
Research Station-Panna Tiger Reserve
Tel: 91-7732-271468
